free_tier.stated: None reachable: Pub/sub only. Zero storage. 1M publishes/month free, but messages are pushed and discarded; there is nothing to read back later.

per_object_cap.stated: Maximum message size is up to 1 MiB per message.

retention.stated: Messages are pushed and discarded; archived data is billed for a minimum of 1 day of storage with no fixed retention period stated.

egress.terms: Data transferred into SNS is free; delivery to Amazon SQS or AWS Lambda is charged at internet data-transfer rates even within one region.

interface_detail: Pub/sub messaging accessed through API requests to SNS topics.
chaining: Fans out to endpoints; payloads can be stored in Amazon S3 via the Extended Client Library, incurring S3 storage charges, but SNS itself holds no readable bytes.
reliability_note: Pub/sub only. Zero storage. 1M publishes/month free, but messages are pushed and discarded; there is nothing to read back later.
confidence_note: Rejection quoted from historical research records; unverified against live endpoints.

evidence.proved: Pub/sub only — zero storage. 1M publishes/month free, but messages are pushed and discarded; there is nothing to read back later.
SNS is a metered pub/sub service; message archiving and replay are a separately priced feature, not a free general blob store
evidence.quote: Message archiving and replay pricing is based on the amount of data you store and the length of time the data is stored for.

evidence.proved: SNS is metered by API requests, indicating an API-based pub/sub interface
evidence.quote: Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) Standard topic pricing is based on the number of monthly API requests made

evidence.proved: the maximum SNS message size is 1 MiB
evidence.quote: Each message from 1KB to the topic's maximum message size (up to 1 MiB) is billed as one message..

evidence.proved: archived messages are billed by storage duration with a one-day minimum, rather than a stated fixed retention
evidence.quote: Any data that is archived will be billed for a minimum of 1 day of storage and message replay is billed at the existing FIFO API Requests and Payload data rates.

evidence.proved: ingress is free; delivery to SQS/Lambda is charged at internet data-transfer rates
evidence.quote: Data transferred into Amazon SNS is free of charge. Amazon SNS does not charge for per-message notification delivery when delivering messages to Amazon SQS or AWS Lambda, but does charge for the amount of data transferred from Amazon SNS to Amazon SQS or AWS Lambda, when messages are delivered.

evidence.proved: SNS chains to S3 through the Extended Client Library, which stores the payload and bills S3 storage
evidence.quote: when using the Amazon SNS Extended Client Library to send payloads using Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3), you incur Amazon S3 charges for any Amazon S3 storage you use to send message payloads.
